title: Anonymous Explicit-Public Project Read
summary: Expose a minimal anonymous project presentation only when canonical project publication state is explicitly public.
resolutionOrder: Read canonical project only after explicit public state is established.
Require publication projectId to match requested projectId.
Require publication ownerCreatorId to match canonical project ownerCreatorId.
Return only sanitized public presentation fields.
privacy: Private and absent publication states are indistinguishable to anonymous callers.
No project graph identifiers are returned.
rightsBoundary: Public presentation does not grant copyright ownership.
Public presentation does not grant master or composition ownership.
Public presentation does not grant publishing, distribution, label, management, royalty, licensing, revenue, collaborator, legal, or account rights.
scope: No public audio or media delivery is introduced.
No migration is authored or executed.
